requirements: Make update(request) idempotent: a request whose id was already applied returns the recorded outcome instead of applying it again. Ownership of a run moves to another controller through adopt(), and only the current owner may change a run. Request ids are unique across all runs and controllers. Runs live only for the life of the process, so recorded outcomes may stay in memory without eviction.

defects.consequence: Replaying a recorded request after adoption reinstalls the former owner and rewrites the run's state without checking who owns it now.

decoys.consequence: adopt silently creates a run for an unknown id, so a typo creates an orphan run.
decoys.evidence: src/runs.js:9 adopt creates a new run when the id is unknown
decoys.reason: adopt reads the existing run and throws on an unknown id; it never creates one.
